target_customer: Developers building document and PDF workflows
problem: Developers need to generate, manipulate, host, sign and track PDFs without stitching tools together.
business_model: Usage-based API plus open source library

founders.name: Pierre Dorge
prior_employers: Lleed and Partners (led digital consulting firm)
education: ETH Zurich and EPFL, computer science

founders.name: Titouan Launay
education: INSA Lyon, civil engineering and architecture

founders.name: Auguste Lefevre
education: Left PhD in quantitative finance, National University of Singapore

technical_complexity.rationale: PDF rendering, signing and tracking are standard but detailed engineering; open source library plus API.

defensibility.rationale: Many HTML to PDF APIs exist and the open source library is easily copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action against Fileforge.

market_need_then: Developers commonly need PDF generation; no demand metrics for Fileforge were found.

branding.domain_note: The YC launch post is titled Onedoc; fileforge.com now belongs to an unrelated digitization firm, so the company used another domain.

rebrands.why: Not stated; sources only show the Onedoc launch post appearing under the Fileforge YC page and CB Insights saying formerly Onedoc Labs

branding.community_and_virality: Posts on dev.to under both names.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collided with an unrelated FileForge business and the product also traded as Onedoc; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Fileforge, formerly Onedoc, was a three founder PDF API company that took YC money and databases show an additional seed from Pioneer Fund. YC lists it inactive but no shutdown notice or cause was found; the docs site appeared live in search. The cause is not public so failure factor is other.
notes: Funding rests on databases and conflicts: CB Insights says $500K total over 3 rounds with a convertible note on 2024-04-03; Bouncewatch lists a $500K pre-seed 2023-12 and a seed 2024-03 from Pioneer Fund; the pre-seed and note may be the same money. Website field empty; fileforge.com belongs to an unrelated company so the company site is treated as dead or moved. Competitor search found only undated vendor pages (DocRaptor, PDFShift) so the list is empty.
